# Portal Access Requirements

> **Source:** CIAM Support documentation - Per-portal access control rules

## Support Portal

### Who Has Access
- Customers with active tenants
- Partners (all types)
- Selected prospects with tenant

### Access Requirement
- **Required Keyword:** `Support` in birthright
- **Can be compensated by:** Entitlement with `Support` keyword

### Common Issues
- **Issue:** Customer missing Support portal after account upgrade
  - **Fix:** Add `Support` to birthright

# CIAM L1 Common Issues & Fixes

> **Source:** CIAM Support documentation - Real L1 support issue patterns and resolutions

## Access Control Issues

### User Cannot Access Support Portal

**Symptoms:**
- User sees "Insufficient permissions" error
- Can access other portals (Community, Academy) normally
- Error message mentions missing "Support" keyword

**Root Causes:**
1. Missing 'Support' keyword in birthright
2. Explicit block keyword (Block-Supp) set
3. Account status not aligned with perso
